ic_name: LIN bus 2.2A (Local Interconnect Network, LIN Consortium)

fsm_states_transmitter.name: TX_IDLE
fsm_states_transmitter.description: SOUT HIGH; THR + TX FIFO empty; THRE=1, TEMT=1.

fsm_states_transmitter.name: TX_START_BIT
fsm_states_transmitter.description: Drive SOUT LOW for 1 bit-time (start bit).

fsm_states_transmitter.name: TX_DATA_BITS
fsm_states_transmitter.description: Shift out 5-8 data bits LSB-first on SOUT, one bit per BAUDOUT/16 cycle.

fsm_states_transmitter.name: TX_PARITY_BIT
fsm_states_transmitter.description: Drive parity bit (even / odd / mark / space) if PEN=1.

fsm_states_transmitter.name: TX_STOP_BITS
fsm_states_transmitter.description: Drive SOUT HIGH for 1, 1.5, or 2 stop bit-times.

fsm_states_transmitter.name: TX_BREAK
fsm_states_transmitter.description: While LCR.BREAK=1: hold SOUT LOW continuously.

fsm_states_receiver.name: RX_START_BIT
fsm_states_receiver.description: Re-sample SIN mid-bit (8 clocks into the bit cell) to confirm valid start; false start-bit detection.

fsm_states_receiver.name: RX_DATA_BITS
fsm_states_receiver.description: Sample SIN mid-bit (every 16th BAUDOUT) and shift into receive shift register LSB-first.

fsm_states_receiver.name: RX_PARITY_BIT
fsm_states_receiver.description: Sample parity bit (if PEN=1) and compare to expected parity.

fsm_states_receiver.name: RX_STOP_BITS
fsm_states_receiver.description: Sample stop bit(s); if 0 then FE=1.

fsm_states_receiver.name: RX_TRANSFER
fsm_states_receiver.description: Move received character + error bits into RBR (char mode) or RX FIFO (FIFO mode); set DR=1.

fsm_states_receiver.name: RX_BREAK_DET
fsm_states_receiver.description: SIN held LOW for ≥ entire character time → BI=1.

fsm_hints.trigger: A break/sync field sequence detected at any time aborts any in-progress slave activity and forces the slave into Active.PID processing for the new frame.
fsm_hints.abort_conditions: Detection of a new break/sync sequence; framing error on any received byte; bit error (TX readback mismatch); checksum mismatch; ID parity mismatch; T_Frame_Maximum exceeded.
fsm_hints.oversampling: Slaves without a precise time base use the alternating edges of the Sync byte (0x55) to measure the master's nominal bit time, then sample subsequent bytes at the centre of each measured bit.

anti_deadlock_rule: Bus arbitration does not exist on LIN; deadlock prevention is by single-master control of timing + collision-resolving schedule tables for event-triggered frames. Any break/sync at any time forces all slaves to abort and restart frame processing — there is no held-bus state that could deadlock a node.
exit_from_reset: After Master Reset (MR=1 for ≥ 1 µs): all registers (except RBR/THR/DLL/DLM) cleared; SOUT, INTR, OUT1, OUT2, RTS, DTR set per Table I. Software must program DLL/DLM (baud) and LCR (framing) before transmission begins.

default_ready_state_recommendation.master_after_reset: Begin schedule processing only after the slave initialisation window has elapsed.
default_ready_state_recommendation.slave_after_reset: Initializing state; LIN protocol behaviour does not apply until Operational entered (≤ 100 ms).

behavior: Transmitter SOUT is set to HIGH-Z and internally connected to receiver SIN.
Modem inputs CTS, DSR, DCD, RI are disconnected from pins; driven instead by MCR bits 0-3 (DTR→DSR, RTS→CTS, OUT1→RI, OUT2→DCD).
Allows software self-test without external loopback.

false_start_bit_detection: On SIN HIGH→LOW edge, receiver waits 8 BAUDOUT clocks (half a bit time) and re-samples; if SIN is still LOW, accept as start bit. Otherwise discard as noise.
interrupt_priority_order: 2: Received Data Available (or FIFO trigger level reached)

fault_confinement_states.name: error active
fault_confinement_states.description: Can take part in bus communication; sends ACTIVE ERROR FLAG (6 dominant bits) on error.

fault_confinement_states.name: error passive
fault_confinement_states.description: Sends PASSIVE ERROR FLAG (6 recessive bits) only; must wait SUSPEND TRANSMISSION (8 recessive bits) before initiating further transmission.

fault_confinement_states.name: bus off
fault_confinement_states.description: Output drivers switched off; no influence on the bus. Recovers to error-active (counters = 0) after 128 occurrences of 11 consecutive recessive bits monitored on the bus.

fsm_hints_transmitter.name: TX_BUS_IDLE
fsm_hints_transmitter.description: Bus idle (≥ 11 consecutive recessive bits). Pending message waits.

fsm_hints_transmitter.name: TX_SOF
fsm_hints_transmitter.description: Transmit START OF FRAME (1 dominant bit); all nodes hard-synchronize.

fsm_hints_transmitter.name: TX_ARBITRATION
fsm_hints_transmitter.description: Send IDENTIFIER + RTR bit by bit; monitor bus. Drove recessive but read dominant → LOSE arbitration → switch to receiver.

fsm_hints_transmitter.name: TX_DATA
fsm_hints_transmitter.description: Send DATA FIELD (0..8 bytes, MSB first within each byte).

fsm_hints_transmitter.name: TX_CRC
fsm_hints_transmitter.description: Send 15-bit CRC SEQUENCE + recessive CRC DELIMITER.

fsm_hints_transmitter.name: TX_ACK_SLOT
fsm_hints_transmitter.description: Drive recessive on ACK SLOT; sample bus; expect a dominant from at least one receiver.

fsm_hints_transmitter.name: TX_EOF
fsm_hints_transmitter.description: Drive 7 recessive bits as END OF FRAME.

fsm_hints_transmitter.name: TX_SUSPEND
fsm_hints_transmitter.description: (error-passive only) Drive 8 recessive SUSPEND TRANSMISSION bits before next transmission.

fsm_hints_receiver.name: RX_BUS_IDLE
fsm_hints_receiver.description: Wait for dominant bit (= START OF FRAME).

fsm_hints_receiver.name: RX_HARD_SYNC
fsm_hints_receiver.description: Hard-synchronize internal bit time to the SOF edge.

fsm_hints_receiver.name: RX_ARBITRATION
fsm_hints_receiver.description: Sample IDENTIFIER + RTR; apply MESSAGE FILTERING locally.

fsm_hints_receiver.name: RX_DATA_COLLECT
fsm_hints_receiver.description: Receive CONTROL + DATA + CRC; resynchronize on each recessive→dominant transition (subject to RJW).

fsm_hints_receiver.name: RX_ACK_GEN
fsm_hints_receiver.description: If CRC matched, drive dominant during ACK SLOT.

fsm_hints_receiver.name: RX_VALIDATE
fsm_hints_receiver.description: If no error up to the last-but-one bit of EOF, message is valid; deliver to object layer.

synchronization_rules: Only one SYNCHRONIZATION within one bit time is allowed.
An edge is used for SYNCHRONIZATION only if the value detected at the previous SAMPLE POINT differs from the bus value immediately after the edge.
HARD SYNCHRONIZATION is performed on the recessive-to-dominant edge during BUS IDLE (= START OF FRAME).
All other recessive-to-dominant edges (and optionally dominant-to-recessive edges at low bit rates) use RESYNCHRONIZATION.
A node transmitting a dominant bit will not RESYNCHRONIZE on a recessive-to-dominant edge with positive PHASE ERROR (when only recessive-to-dominant edges are used).
arbitration_rule: Bitwise on ARBITRATION FIELD (IDENTIFIER + RTR). Each transmitter compares its driven bit to the monitored bus level. Recessive driven + dominant monitored → arbitration lost; transmitter withdraws (does not send any further bits this frame) and may retry when bus is idle.
exit_from_reset_or_wakeup: On wake-up the transfer layer waits for the system's oscillator to stabilize, then waits to synchronize itself to bus activity by checking for 11 consecutive recessive bits before switching bus drivers to 'on-bus'.
default_signal_state_when_bus_free: Bus idle = all nodes drive recessive (= released; pulled to recessive by the physical layer).
wake_up_message_identifier: Special wake-up message uses the dedicated lowest-priority IDENTIFIER 'rrr rrrd rrrr' (r=recessive, d=dominant).

fsm_states_master_task.name: Idle
fsm_states_master_task.description: No frame scheduled. Wait for the next schedule-table tick whose slot is due for transportation.

fsm_states_master_task.name: Break
fsm_states_master_task.description: Send Break field (≥13 dominant nominal bit times + ≥1 recessive bit Break Delimiter).

fsm_states_master_task.name: Sync
fsm_states_master_task.description: Send Sync byte field (0x55) as a UART byte field.

fsm_states_master_task.name: PID
fsm_states_master_task.description: Send Protected Identifier byte field (ID0..ID5 + P0 + P1). After PID is sent, transition back to Idle to await next slot (master may simultaneously act as slave-task publisher/subscriber on its own slave task).

fsm_states_slave_task_processor.name: Idle
fsm_states_slave_task_processor.description: Receive break and sync. Wait for break/sync field sequence.

fsm_states_slave_task_processor.name: Active.PID
fsm_states_slave_task_processor.description: Receive PID byte. If unknown PID or framing error → Quit (back to Idle). Else dispatch by PID role.

fsm_states_slave_task_processor.name: Active.RxData
fsm_states_slave_task_processor.description: Receive each data byte. On framing error → Error. After all data bytes received → RxChecksum.

fsm_states_slave_task_processor.name: Active.RxChecksum
fsm_states_slave_task_processor.description: Receive checksum byte. If checksum valid → Success. If invalid or framing error → Error.

fsm_states_slave_task_processor.name: Active.TxData
fsm_states_slave_task_processor.description: Transmit each data byte; perform UART readback. If readback ≠ sent → Error. After all bytes sent → TxChecksum.

fsm_states_slave_task_processor.name: Active.TxChecksum
fsm_states_slave_task_processor.description: Transmit checksum byte with readback. If readback correct → Success. Else → Error.

fsm_states_slave_task_processor.name: Success
fsm_states_slave_task_processor.description: Successful_transfer flag set. Return to Idle.

fsm_states_slave_task_processor.name: Error
fsm_states_slave_task_processor.description: Error_in_response flag set; response_error signal set on next status-carrying unconditional frame. Return to Idle.

fsm_states_slave_task_processor.name: Quit (unknown PID / no role)
fsm_states_slave_task_processor.description: Slave is not publisher nor subscriber of this PID — no further action this slot.

network_management_state_machine_slave_n.entry: First connection to power source, reset, or wakeup.
network_management_state_machine_slave_n.duration: Init process must finish within 100 ms.

network_management_state_machine_slave_n.behaviour: LIN protocol (TX/RX of frames) applies only in this state.
network_management_state_machine_slave_n.exit: Go-to-sleep request received OR bus inactive for 4 to 10 s → Bus sleep mode.

network_management_state_machine_slave_n.behaviour: Bus level is recessive; only the wake-up signal may be transmitted on the cluster.
network_management_state_machine_slave_n.exit: Wake-up signal received OR internal reason to wake up the cluster → Initializing.

wake_up_protocol.wake_signal_generation: Any node forces the bus dominant for 250 µs to 5 ms, then releases to recessive.
wake_up_protocol.slave_wake_detection: Dominant pulse > 150 µs followed by rising edge.
wake_up_protocol.retry_protocol: If wake-up not acknowledged (no break from master in 150-250 ms), node may retransmit wake signal. After 3 failed attempts a node shall wait at least 1.5 s before issuing a 4th wake signal.
wake_up_protocol.block_pattern: One block of up to 3 wake signals separated by 150-250 ms; ≥ 1.5 s pause between blocks (recommended).

go_to_sleep_protocol.slave_action: Slaves shall interpret only the first data field; data2..data8 = 0xFF are ignored. The request need not enforce the slave application into low-power mode (application-specific).
go_to_sleep_protocol.automatic_sleep: Slave automatically enters bus sleep mode after 4..10 s of bus inactivity even without an explicit Go-To-Sleep command.
